english.text: Confucius said: " Yu the Great's conduct, I could not point out any flaws. He consumes meager amount of food, while offering boastful riches to the Gods and ancestors; He always don the crudest attire, but wears lavish garments when worshipping; He resides in a small house, yet forges water ways and ditches with all his might. Figures like Yu the Great, I honestly cannot point out any reprehensible flaws."

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I walked to Tim Hortons café at about 5, then later at 9, this chilly but sunny morning of the 29th of June of 2025. I enjoyed an Earl Grey tea with oat milk, a Sausage Egg English Muffin, an Iced Coffee with oat milk, and a Scrambled Egg Sausage Potato Box. I was thinking there at my table about my adolescent days when I was fascinated with enclosed shopping malls, like Lulu Island's Richmond Centre and Lansdowne Centre, as well as Vancouver's Harbour Centre Mall, and reflecting on future space colonies on Luna, Mars, Saturn's moon Titan, and Neptune's moon Triton, as I tied the ideas with the speculative fiction that I was reading and watching then. Of course, that time was before the advent of advanced Artificial Intelligence that we have today and the observance of the years passing by with such slow progress in crewed space travel. I have had to adjust my vision of the future, accordingly. Maybe, AI will help humans to that end? Or, maybe, AI will be the major player?

text: 我喺2025年6月29號呢個凍冰冰但晴朗嘅朝早，大約五點行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，然後九點，我享用咗一杯配埋燕麥奶嘅灰伯爵茶、一個香腸蛋英式鬆餅、一杯燕麥奶嘅冰咖啡，同埋一個炒蛋香腸薯仔盒。我享用咗一杯伯爵茶配燕麥奶，一個香腸蛋英式鬆餅，一個冰咖啡配燕麥奶，同埋一個炒蛋香腸青少年薯仔盒，當我諗緊我喺嗰度買嘢嘅時候商場，例如露露島嘅里士滿中心同蘭斯頓中心，同埋溫哥華嘅海港中心商場，同埋反思未來嘅月球、火星、土星嘅衛星泰坦同海王星嘅衛星三角洲嘅太空殖民地，當我將呢啲想法同我當時睇緊同睇緊嘅投機小說結合埋一齊嘅時候，當然，嗰個時代係喺我哋有嘅智慧同先進嘅智慧出現之前嘅船員太空旅行嘅進展緩慢，我都要相應噉調整我對未來嘅願景。可能，人工智能會幫到人類去到呢個地步？或者，可能，人工智能會係主要嘅參與者？
